docs.text: ForgeLab is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 9pm, and Saturday from 10am to 6pm. ForgeLab is closed on Sundays and public holidays.
docs.title: Opening hours

docs.text: ForgeLab has two Prusa MK4 3D printers. Book a printer on the ForgeLab booking board. Each booking is limited to a maximum of 4 hours, and filament is charged by weight.
docs.title: 3D printers

docs.text: The 60W CO2 laser cutter may only be used after completing the laser induction session. Approved materials are acrylic and plywood. PVC and vinyl are never allowed because they release toxic gas.
docs.title: Laser cutter

docs.text: Eye protection is mandatory in the workshop zone at all times. The first-aid kit is kept by the entrance door, and any injury must be reported to the duty supervisor.
docs.title: Safety rules

docs.text: Membership is free for SRM students with a valid student ID card. External members pay 500 rupees per semester. Membership includes access to all hand tools and the soldering stations.
docs.title: Membership

docs.text: ForgeLab has four soldering stations with lead-free solder provided. Soldering irons must be returned to their stands after use, and the extractor fan must be switched on while soldering.
docs.title: Soldering stations

docs.text: Cancel a booking at least 2 hours before it starts or you lose the slot. Two no-shows in a month lead to a one-week suspension of booking privileges.
docs.title: Booking rules

docs.text: The CNC mill is staff-operated only. Submit your CAD file by Thursday for a Friday job. Staff will confirm the material and the estimated machining time before starting.
docs.title: CNC mill

docs.text: An introduction to 3D printing workshop runs on the first Saturday of every month at 11am. No prior experience is needed and all materials are provided.
docs.title: Workshops

docs.text: Project lockers cost 100 rupees per month and can be rented for a maximum of 3 months. Lockers must be emptied by the end of the rental period.
docs.title: Project lockers
